glosses: The god of love, son of Venus; sometimes depicted as a putto (a naked, winged boy with bow and arrow). The Roman counterpart of Eros.

examples.text: The myth of Cupid and Psyche was one of the most influential romances in European culture.

glosses: Sudden love or desire; the personification of falling in love.

examples.text: He was just walking down the street minding his own business when Cupid struck.
